nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 金斯敦一间社区录音棚正在准备晚间节目。片头音乐已经完成，主持人的第一句话却因为文件损坏只剩最后几个音节。

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: We need a new opening. Clear enough for visitors, but it should still sound like it belongs here.

options.text: 「Can I hear how local listeners usually greet each other first?」
「I'll copy the accent and make it sound local.」

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: Yes. Listen for meaning and rhythm first. You don't need to imitate an accent to sound warm.

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: Don't perform someone else's voice. Understand the meaning, then speak naturally in your own.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Aaliyah 播放三段旧节目。每位主持人用词不同，但都先欢迎听众，再说明今晚会听到什么。

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: It means everyone is welcome and settled in. Jamaican Creole and Standard English can carry different shades of the same idea.

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: Different doesn't mean incorrect. Ask what it means here, then choose language that fits your audience and your own voice.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你写下开场：Good evening, Kingston and everyone listening beyond the city. Settle in — tonight, local voices lead the way。

nodes.speaker: Aaliyah
nodes.text: Clear, welcoming, and honest. You learned from the local rhythm without pretending it was yours.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 红色录音灯亮起。你的第一句顺利接住片头音乐，窗外晚风也恰好把街上的低音送进来。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】节目继续播放。你记住了比模仿更重要的顺序：先听、再问、理解之后再表达。
